items.title: Conditional inspection
items.description: Experimental aircraft: the operating limitations require a condition inspection within the preceding 12 calendar months, to the scope of 14 CFR Part 43 Appendix D, by the holder of the repairman certificate or an A&P.

items.title: 100-hour inspection
items.description: Only if operated for hire or used for flight instruction for hire (14 CFR 91.409(b)).

items.title: ELT inspection
items.description: Emergency locator transmitter inspected within the preceding 12 calendar months (14 CFR 91.207(d)).

items.title: Transponder test
items.description: Tested and inspected within the preceding 24 calendar months (14 CFR 91.413).

items.title: Altimeter & pitot-static test
items.description: Required for IFR operations; within the preceding 24 calendar months (14 CFR 91.411).

items.title: Oil change
items.description: Oil and filter every 50 engine hours. Sooner if the engine manual says so, or if the airplane sits between flights.
